name: Scenario A — Moderate Monsoon Flooding
description: Localized waterlogging in low-lying sections of North Chennai; major arterial corridors and bridges remain operational.

name: Scenario B — Severe Urban Inundation
description: Adyar river and Buckingham canal discharge peak; key arterial river bridges and Pallikaranai marsh causeway submerged.

name: Scenario C — Critical Multi-Basin Emergency
description: Catastrophic event analogous to historic 2015/Michaung flood. Cooum, Adyar, and Kosasthalaiyar basins breach; extensive road network severance.
